intro: Slovak culture is rooted in mountain villages, wooden churches and folk songs.

chapters.title: Folk traditions
text: Wooden churches in the Carpathians and the log village of Vlkolínec are World Heritage Sites. Juraj Jánošík, an 18th-century outlaw said to steal from the rich and give to the poor, is a folk hero.

The national dish is bryndzové halušky, small potato dumplings with sheep's cheese and bacon. Andy Warhol's parents came from a Slovak village, and there is a museum of his work in north-eastern Slovakia.

chapters.title: Music and dance
text: Folk festivals bring together musicians and dancers in colourful costumes every summer, and the fujara's deep sound is a symbol of Slovak shepherd life.
